title: The Framing-to-Misalignment Causal Chain: Identifying the Mechanistic Link

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Identifying the mechanistic link between framing and misalignment suppression would explain why framing works and suggest more targeted interventions. Direct causal understanding of a known safety defense.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires fine-tuning two models (with and without framing), then applying activation patching across layers and attention heads. Activation patching is an advanced interpretability technique that requires careful setup and interpretation. Beyond most beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two fine-tuning runs plus systematic activation patching across layers and heads is multi-phase. Interpreting which representations differ and hypothesizing the causal link is open-ended. Likely exceeds 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
